config.consensus.voting_method.strict-majority: strict majority, which needs more than half of the votes cast
config.consensus.voting_method.plurality: plurality, which needs the unique highest vote count

config.consensus.include_backbone_vote.yes: the backbone cast one vote next to them

config.consensus.min_callable_isolates.*: Positions with fewer than {} callable isolates were written as N.

config.consensus.unresolved_single_base.iupac: written as the IUPAC code of the alleles that received votes

config.consensus.tie_source.backbone: A tie was settled by the backbone allele
config.consensus.tie_source.isolate: A tie was settled by the allele of isolate

config.consensus.tie_scope.tied-alleles: when it was one of the tied alleles; otherwise the tie stayed unresolved.
config.consensus.tie_scope.any-allele: , also when it was not one of the tied alleles or received no vote.
